answer_1.quote: We present GraphNarrator, the first method to generate natural language explanations for GNNs...
answer_1.outputs: Paragraph-length natural language explanations for graph model predictions

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation is applied to evaluate the faithfulness and brevity of explanations. Following previous research, Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) and Simulatability (Simul.) are used as indicators for faithfulness... For Brevity, the average ratio of explanation length and input length is used as an indicator.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human annotation to investigate how human readers view the quality of explanations... We recruit three annotators... the annotators are asked to rate on a scale of 1-7 whether the explanations were (1) easy to understand, (2) insightful for the underlying decision process, (3) informative in preserving graph semantics, (4) informative in preserving graph structures.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate explanations on a 1-7 scale for ease of understanding, insightfulness, semantic informativeness, and structural informativeness.
criteria: insightful for the underlying decision process
